title: Ritorik vositalar va nutq san’ati
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ritorik savol, uchlik, antiteza va takrorni ongli ishlatasiz, ishontiruvchi nutq tuzilmasini tuzasiz, mashhur nutqni tahlil qilasiz va nutqni pauza hamda urg‘u bilan ijro etasiz.

scenes.title: Nutq san’atiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bugungi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda frazeologizmlar va maqollarning nozik ma’nolarini o‘rgandik. Endi gap shunchaki to‘g‘ri gapirishda emas, balki odamlarni ishontirishda. Bugun ritorik savol, uchlik, qarama-qarshilik va takrorni o‘rganasiz, ishontiruvchi nutq tuzilmasini tuzasiz, mashhur nutqlarni tahlil qilasiz va ijro texnikasini mashq qilasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome. Good speakers are made, not born. Today you will learn the tools that great orators have used for two and a half thousand years.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Yaxshi notiqlar tug‘ilmaydi, tarbiyalanadi. Bugun buyuk notiqlar ikki yarim ming yildan beri foydalanib kelayotgan vositalarni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Ritorika nima?

examples.t: As a doctor, I have seen this daily.
examples.uz: Shifokor sifatida men buni har kuni ko‘rganman. (ethos)

examples.t: Imagine losing your home overnight.

scenes.say_native: Ritorika qadimgi Yunonistondan kelgan fan bo‘lib, so‘zni ishontirish uchun ongli ravishda qurishni o‘rgatadi. Aristotel uchta ustunni ajratgan: ethos, ya’ni gapiruvchiga ishonch; pathos, ya’ni tinglovchining his-tuyg‘usi; logos, ya’ni mantiq va dalil. Kuchli nutq uchalasini ham ishlatadi. Bugungi vositalar asosan so‘zlarni qurish usullaridir.
scenes.say: Aristotle named three appeals. Ethos is your credibility, pathos is the emotion you stir, and logos is the logic of your case.
scenes.say_uz: Aristotel uchta ta’sir usulini nomlagan. Ethos sizning ishonchliligingiz, pathos uyg‘otadigan his-tuyg‘u, logos esa dalilingizning mantig‘i.

scenes.title: Ritorik savol

examples.t: Who wouldn't want a safer city?
If you prick us, do we not bleed?

scenes.say_native: Ritorik savol javob olish uchun emas, fikrni kuchaytirish uchun beriladi. U savol shaklidagi da’vodir: javob hammaga ayon deb hisoblanadi. Masalan, “Who could disagree?” degani “Hech kim rozi bo‘lmaydi” demak. O‘zbek tilida ham “Axir, kim xohlaydi?” deymiz, ya’ni bu vosita sizga tanish, faqat inglizcha ohangi va iboralarini bilish kerak.
scenes.say: A rhetorical question is a statement in disguise. It invites the audience to supply the obvious answer for themselves.
scenes.say_uz: Ritorik savol niqoblangan da’vodir. U tinglovchini aniq javobni o‘zi topishga undaydi.

scenes.title: Ritorik savol turlari
board: Who…? · How long…? · What kind of…?

examples.t: How long must we wait?
Is it not time we acted?
What kind of world are we building?

scenes.say_native: Ritorik savol ko‘pincha “who”, “how long”, “what kind of” bilan boshlanadi yoki inkor shaklida keladi: “Is it not time…?” Inkor shakli rasmiyroq va ko‘tarinki ohangga ega. Eslatib o‘tay, bunday savollardan keyin nutqda qisqa pauza qilinadi: shu pauzada tinglovchi ichida javob beradi. Pauzani o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, vosita o‘z kuchini yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: How long must we wait? Is it not time we acted? What kind of country do we want to leave our children?
scenes.say_uz: Yana qancha kutamiz? Harakat qilish vaqti kelmadimi? Farzandlarimizga qanday mamlakat qoldirmoqchimiz?

scenes.title: Ritorik savolni haddan ortiq ishlatish
board: ✗ Five rhetorical questions in a row
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — ritorik savollarni ketma-ket tizib tashlash. Besh savoldan keyin tinglovchi javobni kutmay, charchaydi, ba’zan esa gapiruvchi o‘zi javob bera olmayotgandek tuyuladi. Qoida: bir ma’no bloki uchun bitta kuchli savol, keyin pauza, keyin javobingiz. Ikkinchi xato — savolga javob berilmagan holda shunchaki mavzuni almashtirish.
scenes.say: One question, well placed, is powerful. A string of five sounds like panic. Ask it, pause, and then answer it yourself.
scenes.say_uz: Joyida berilgan bitta savol kuchli. Beshta ketma-ket savol vahimaga o‘xshaydi. So‘rang, to‘xtang, so‘ng o‘zingiz javob bering.

scenes.title: Uchlik: tricolon
board: Veni, vidi, vici — I came, I saw, I conquered

examples.t: I came, I saw, I conquered.
Government of the people, by the people, for the people.
examples.uz: Xalqning, xalq tomonidan, xalq uchun hukumat. (Linkoln)

examples.t: Stop, think, act.

scenes.say_native: Tricolon — uchta o‘xshash tuzilishli bo‘lakning ketma-ket kelishi. Uch — eng yoqimli son: ikkita bo‘lak oddiy sanoq, uchtasi esa to‘liq, tugallangan tuyuladi. Eng mashhur misol — Yuliy Tsezarga mansub “Veni, vidi, vici”. Odatda bo‘laklar uzunlashib boradi va eng kuchlisi oxirida turadi. Bu vositani o‘zbek nutqida ham “uchlik” sifatida ko‘p uchratamiz.
scenes.say: Three is the magic number. Two items feel like a list, but three feel complete, and the third should be the strongest.
scenes.say_uz: Uch sehrli son. Ikkita narsa ro‘yxatga o‘xshaydi, uchta esa tugal tuyuladi, uchinchisi esa eng kuchlisi bo‘lishi kerak.

scenes.title: Uchlikni qurish
board: Same grammar in all three parts

examples.t: Fast, cheap and reliable.
We will work harder, think smarter and aim higher.
examples.uz: Ko‘proq mehnat qilamiz, aqlliroq o‘ylaymiz, balandroq maqsad qo‘yamiz.

scenes.say_native: Uchlik ishlashi uchun uchala bo‘lak grammatik jihatdan bir xil qurilishi kerak: uchta fe’l, uchta sifat yoki uchta ot birikmasi. Ikkinchi qoida — o‘sib borish: qisqa, o‘rtacha, eng uzun yoki eng kuchli. Uchinchisi — ritm. Ohang birinchi va ikkinchi bo‘lakda ko‘tarilib turadi, uchinchisida pasayib, gapni yopadi.
scenes.say: A good tricolon builds. We need courage, we need patience, and above all we need a plan we can all believe in.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi uchlik o‘sib boradi. Bizga jasorat kerak, sabr kerak va hammadan ko‘ra, hamma ishona oladigan reja kerak.

scenes.title: Buzilgan parallellik
board: ✗ She is smart, hardworking and has kindness
✓ She is smart, hardworking and kind
✗ to plan, organising and to lead
✓ to plan, to organise and to lead
scenes.say_native: Uzbek tilida ham, inglizchada ham uchlikni buzadigan xato — parallellikning yo‘qolishi. Ikkita sifatdan keyin to‘satdan “has kindness” deb gapni boshqa qurilishga o‘tkazib yuborish nutqni nozik eshitiladigan qiladi. Fe’llar bilan ham shunday: “to plan, organising, to lead” notekis, “to plan, to organise, to lead” esa toza. Har uchala bo‘lakni bir xil shaklda yozing.
scenes.say: Keep the parts parallel. Not smart, hardworking and has kindness, but smart, hardworking and kind.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘laklarni parallel saqlang. “Smart, hardworking and has kindness” emas, “smart, hardworking and kind”.

scenes.title: Uchlik tuzing
scenes.say_native: Endi mashq. Birinchi vazifa: “o‘rganish” haqida uchta parallel fe’l bilan gap tuzing. Ikkinchi vazifa: “A clear, honest and ___” gapini tugallang va oxirgi so‘z eng kuchlisi bo‘lsin. Uchinchi: bitta ritorik savol o‘ylab toping. Baland ovozda ayting, pauza bilan.
scenes.say: Make a tricolon about learning. Then finish this one: a clear, honest and what? Add a rhetorical question of your own.
scenes.say_uz: O‘rganish haqida uchlik tuzing. Keyin buni tugallang: aniq, halol va qanday? O‘zingizning ritorik savolingizni qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Mashq javoblari
board: We read, we practise, we improve.
a clear, honest and fearless account
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar: “We read, we practise, we improve” — uchta parallel fe’l, oxirgisi natija. “A clear, honest and fearless account” — uchinchi so‘z eng kuchli. Ritorik savol: “What are we waiting for?” Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi — uch bo‘lak bir xil shaklda va eng kuchlisi oxirida.
scenes.say: We read, we practise, we improve. A clear, honest and fearless account. What are we waiting for?
scenes.say_uz: Biz o‘qiymiz, mashq qilamiz, yaxshilanamiz. Aniq, halol va qo‘rqmas hisobot. Nimani kutyapmiz?

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik: antiteza
board: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times

examples.t: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times.
examples.uz: Bu eng yaxshi zamon edi, bu eng yomon zamon edi. (Dikkens)

examples.t: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
Not words, but deeds.

scenes.say_native: Antiteza — ikki qarama-qarshi fikrni bir xil tuzilishda yonma-yon qo‘yish. Qarshilik kontrastni yaqqol ko‘rsatadi va gapni yodda qoldiradi. Dikkensning “A Tale of Two Cities” romani boshlanishi klassik misol. Grammatika jihatdan ikki qism aynan bir xil qurilishda bo‘ladi, faqat kalit so‘zlar teskari. Bu o‘zbek maqollaridagi juftliklarga ham o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say: Antithesis sets opposites side by side in matching grammar. The contrast makes both halves sharper.
scenes.say_uz: Antiteza qarama-qarshi tushunchalarni bir xil grammatikada yonma-yon qo‘yadi. Qarama-qarshilik ikkala yarmini ham ravshanroq qiladi.

scenes.title: Xiazm: chiasmus
board: Ask not what your country can do for you—ask what you can do for your country.

examples.t: Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.
examples.uz: Vataningiz siz uchun nima qila olishini so‘ramang, siz vatan uchun nima qila olishingizni so‘rang.

scenes.say_native: Antitezaning nafis ko‘rinishi — xiazm: tuzilma ko‘zgudagidek teskari bo‘ladi, A-B, keyin B-A. Eng mashhur misol — Jon Kennedining 1961 yildagi inauguratsiya nutqi: “Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.” Fikr burilib, mas’uliyat tinglovchining o‘ziga qaytadi. Bu vosita juda yodda qoladi, shuning uchun uni nutqda ko‘pi bilan bir marta ishlating.
scenes.say: Chiasmus reverses the order of the words in the second half. It turns the audience's attention back on itself.
scenes.say_uz: Xiazm ikkinchi yarmida so‘zlar tartibini teskari qiladi. U tinglovchi e’tiborini o‘ziga qaytaradi.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik noto‘g‘ri
board: ✗ Not only is it cheap but also is it good
✓ It is not only cheap but also good
scenes.say_native: Antitezada eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — ikki yarmi tuzilishi bo‘yicha mos kelmasligi. Ikkinchi xato — “not only … but also” da tartibni buzish. Salbiy qism boshiga qo‘yilsa, inversiya kerak: “Not only is it cheap, but it is also good.” Oddiy tartibda esa: “It is not only cheap but also good.” Uchinchi xato — “however” ni juft qism sifatida ishlatish; u bog‘lovchi emas, kirish so‘zidir.
scenes.say: Mind the structure. It is not only cheap but also good. Or, with inversion: not only is it cheap, but it is also good.
scenes.say_uz: Tuzilishga e’tibor bering. U nafaqat arzon, balki yaxshi ham. Yoki inversiya bilan: nafaqat arzon, balki yaxshi ham.

scenes.title: Qarama-qarshilik toping
board: 2. Reverse: 'You can do X for Y'
3. Fix: not only is it cheap but also is it good
scenes.say_native: Uchta topshiriq. Birinchi: “work” va “play” so‘zlari bilan antiteza tuzing. Ikkinchi: “We shape our buildings” gapini xiazm qilib, ikkinchi yarmini tuzing. Uchinchi: “Not only is it cheap but also is it good” gapini to‘g‘rilang. Ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Build an antithesis with work and play. Complete a chiasmus after: we shape our buildings. Then fix the broken sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Work va play bilan antiteza tuzing. “We shape our buildings” dan keyin xiazmni tugallang. So‘ng noto‘g‘ri gapni tuzating.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: Work hard, play hard / We work to live, not live to work
Not only is it cheap, but it is also good.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “We work to live; we do not live to work” yoki “All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy” maqoli ham antiteza elementlariga ega. Ikkinchi: “We shape our buildings, and afterwards our buildings shape us” — bu Churchillga mansub mashhur xiazm. Uchinchi: “Not only is it cheap, but it is also good.”
scenes.say: We work to live; we do not live to work. We shape our buildings, and afterwards our buildings shape us. Not only is it cheap, but it is also good.
scenes.say_uz: Biz yashash uchun ishlaymiz, ishlash uchun yashamaymiz. Biz binolarimizni shakllantiramiz, so‘ng binolarimiz bizni shakllantiradi. U nafaqat arzon, balki yaxshi ham.

scenes.title: Takror: anafora va epifora

examples.t: We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight in the fields.
examples.uz: Biz sohillarda jang qilamiz, dalalarda jang qilamiz. (Cherchill)

examples.t: I have a dream that one day… I have a dream today.

scenes.say_native: Takror — nutqning eng kuchli vositalaridan biri. Anafora: bir necha gap bir xil so‘z bilan boshlanadi, masalan, “We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds”. Epifora: gaplar bir xil so‘z bilan tugaydi. Linkolnning “of the people, by the people, for the people” iborasida “the people” oxirida takrorlanadi. Takror ritm yaratadi va asosiy g‘oyani yodga o‘rnatadi.
scenes.say: Anaphora repeats the opening words. Epistrophe repeats the closing words. Both build rhythm and drive an idea home.
scenes.say_uz: Anafora boshlanishni takrorlaydi. Epifora oxirini takrorlaydi. Ikkalasi ham ritm yaratadi va g‘oyani mustahkamlaydi.

scenes.title: Takror amalda
scenes.say_native: Mana, anaforaning ishlashi. “Every child deserves…” uch marta takrorlanadi, har safar oxiri o‘zgaradi va ohang o‘sadi. Bu uchlik bilan anaforaning uyg‘unligi. Eslab qoling: takror faqat bir xil so‘z emas, bu ongli tanlov. Tinglovchi takrorlanishni uchinchi marta kutadi va uni eshitganda qoniqish tuyadi.
scenes.say: Every child deserves a teacher. Every child deserves a book. Every child deserves a chance.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir bola o‘qituvchiga loyiq. Har bir bola kitobga loyiq. Har bir bola imkoniyatga loyiq.

scenes.title: Takror va zerikarli takror
board: ✗ Very, very, very important and really, really big
scenes.say_native: Takror bilan oddiy so‘z-parazit takrorini adashtirmang. “It is very, very, very important” — bu nutq kuchi emas, kuchsizlik. Kuchli takror struktura takrori: bir xil boshlanish, lekin har safar yangi ma’no qo‘shiladi. Ikkinchi xato — takrorni juda ko‘p marta qilish: uch yoki to‘rt marta yetarli. Beshinchi marta tinglovchi charchaydi.
scenes.say: Repetition must build. Not very, very, very important, but: it matters to families, it matters to firms, it matters to our future.
scenes.say_uz: Takror o‘sib borishi kerak. “Juda, juda muhim” emas, balki: bu oilalar uchun muhim, kompaniyalar uchun muhim, kelajagimiz uchun muhim.

scenes.title: Anafora tuzing
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi: “We need…” bilan boshlanuvchi uchta gap tuzing, mavzu — sog‘lom shahar. Ikkinchi: bir gapda anafora va uchlikni qo‘shing. Uchinchi: “Fight them on the beaches” iborasidagi vositani nomlang. Ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Write three sentences starting with we need, about a healthy city. Which device is we shall fight on the beaches?
scenes.say_uz: Sog‘lom shahar haqida “we need” bilan boshlanuvchi uchta gap yozing. “We shall fight on the beaches” qaysi vosita?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: We need clean air. We need green parks. We need safe streets.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “We need clean air. We need green parks. We need safe streets.” Bu anafora va uchlik birgalikda. Cherchilldagi “we shall fight” — anafora, chunki gaplar bir xil so‘z bilan boshlanadi. Yodingizda tursin: vositalar birga ishlaydi, eng yaxshi nutqlar ularni qatlam-qatlam qo‘yadi.
scenes.say: We need clean air. We need green parks. We need safe streets. That is anaphora and tricolon working together.
scenes.say_uz: Bizga toza havo kerak. Bizga yashil bog‘lar kerak. Bizga xavfsiz ko‘chalar kerak. Bu anafora va uchlikning birga ishlashi.

scenes.title: Ishontiruvchi nutq tuzilmasi
scenes.say_native: Ishontiruvchi nutq ko‘pincha besh bosqichdan iborat. Birinchi: hook, ya’ni e’tiborni tortuvchi boshlanish — savol, hikoya yoki hayratlanarli fakt. Ikkinchi: asosiy da’vo. Uchinchi: dalillar. To‘rtinchi: qarshi fikrni tan olib, unga javob berish. Beshinchi: harakatga chaqiriq. Qarshi fikrni e’tiborsiz qoldirmang: uni siz keltirsangiz, ishonchingiz oshadi.
scenes.say: A persuasive speech has a shape: a hook, a clear claim, evidence, an answer to the other side, and finally a call to action.
scenes.say_uz: Ishontiruvchi nutqning shakli bor: hook, aniq da’vo, dalil, qarshi tomonga javob va oxirida harakatga chaqiriq.

scenes.title: Hook turlari
board: A question · A story · A startling fact

examples.t: Picture a classroom with no windows.
What if tomorrow, nothing worked?

scenes.say_native: Boshlanish tinglovchi e’tiborini birinchi o‘n soniyada oladi. Beshta yo‘l bor: ritorik savol, qisqa shaxsiy hikoya, kutilmagan fakt, iqtibos yoki dadil bayonot. Hikoya eng kuchli, chunki odamlar hikoyani eslab qoladi. “Bugun nutqimni boshlayman” kabi bo‘sh kirishlardan saqlaning, ular vaqtni yeydi va e’tiborni susaytiradi.
scenes.say: Picture a classroom with no windows, no books and no teacher. For millions of children, that is not a picture; it is a Monday morning.
scenes.say_uz: Derazasiz, kitobsiz, o‘qituvchisiz sinfni tasavvur qiling. Millionlab bolalar uchun bu tasavvur emas, dushanba ertalabi.

scenes.title: Qarshi fikr va harakatga chaqiriq
board: Call to action: 'So today I ask you to…'

examples.t: Some will say it costs too much.
So today I ask you to vote yes.
examples.uz: Shuning uchun bugun sizdan ha deb ovoz berishingizni so‘rayman.

scenes.say_native: Qarshi fikrni bunday kiritamiz: “Some will say… but…” yoki “It is true that… yet…”. Siz avval tan olasiz, keyin rad etasiz, shunda adolatli ko‘rinasiz. Yakunda esa aniq harakat so‘raladi: “So today I ask you to sign.” Noaniq “we should think about it” o‘rniga bitta aniq qadam tanlang. Eng kuchli tugatish — boshidagi hikoyaga qaytish.
scenes.say: Some will say it costs too much. It is true that it is not cheap, yet doing nothing costs far more. So today I ask you to vote yes.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zilar bu juda qimmat deydi. To‘g‘ri, u arzon emas, biroq hech narsa qilmaslik ancha qimmatga tushadi. Shuning uchun bugun sizdan ha deb ovoz berishingizni so‘rayman.

scenes.title: Nutq tuzilmasidagi xatolar
board: ✓ Opening: a story or a startling fact
✗ Ending: 'Thank you, that's all, I think.'
✓ Ending: a clear call to action
scenes.say_native: Ko‘p o‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilar nutqni “Bugun men … haqida gapirib beraman” deb boshlaydi, ingliz tilida esa bu zaif ochilish. Ikkinchi xato — zaif tugatish: “That’s all, I think” yoki “Thank you for listening” deb darrov to‘xtash. Eng yaxshi tugatish — aniq chaqiriq yoki esda qoladigan oxirgi jumla, minnatdorchilik undan keyin, bir soniya pauzadan so‘ng.
scenes.say: Do not announce your topic. Start with a story. And never fade out; end with a call to action, then a short thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzuni e’lon qilmang. Hikoyadan boshlang. Va hech qachon so‘nib ketmang: harakatga chaqiriq bilan tugating, so‘ng qisqa rahmat ayting.

scenes.title: Nutq qismlarini aniqlang
board: A. 'Imagine waking up with no water.'
B. 'Some will say it is too late.'
scenes.say_native: Uch gap berilgan, har biri nutqning qaysi qismi ekanini ayting: hook, qarshi fikr yoki harakatga chaqiriq. Birinchi: “Imagine waking up with no water.” Ikkinchi: “Some will say it is too late.” Uchinchi: “So please sign today.” Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Which part of a speech is it? Imagine waking up with no water. Some will say it is too late. So please sign today.
scenes.say_uz: Bu nutqning qaysi qismi? Suvsiz uyg‘onishni tasavvur qiling. Ba’zilar juda kech deydi. Shuning uchun bugun imzo qo‘ying.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi gap — hook, chunki u tinglovchini voqeaga tortadi. Ikkinchi — qarshi fikrni tan olish: “Some will say…”. Uchinchi — harakatga chaqiriq, buyruq va aniq qadam bor. Bu uchtasini nutqingizda shu tartibda ishlatsangiz, tuzilma tayyor.
scenes.say: The first is a hook, the second is a concession, and the third is a call to action.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchisi hook, ikkinchisi qarshi fikrni tan olish, uchinchisi harakatga chaqiriq.

scenes.title: Tinglash: nutq bo‘yicha maslahat
board: Listen: Maya and her coach, Mr Reid
Q1 What is wrong with the opening?
Q2 What does he suggest for the ending?
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi tinglash. Maya va uning murabbiyi janob Rid maktab tanlovi nutqi haqida gaplashadi. Diqqat bilan eshiting va ikki savolga javob toping: Mayaning boshlanishida nima xato va murabbiy yakun uchun nima taklif qiladi. Matn tabiiy tezlikda aytiladi.
scenes.say: Maya: I open with, Today I'd like to talk about recycling. Mr Reid: Too flat, Maya. Start with a story. Tell them about the beach you cleaned. Maya: And the ending? Mr Reid: Don't fade out. Ask them to act: sign up this week.
scenes.say_uz: Maya: Men “Bugun qayta ishlash haqida gapirmoqchiman” deb boshlayman. Janob Rid: Juda yassi, Maya. Hikoyadan boshlang. Tozalagan sohilingiz haqida gapiring. Maya: Yakuni-chi? Janob Rid: So‘nib ketmang. Harakatga chaqiring: shu hafta ro‘yxatdan o‘ting.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: Q1 What is wrong with the opening?
Q2 What is the ending advice?
Q3 Which device is the beach story?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: Mayaning ochilishida nima muammo? Ikkinchi: murabbiy yakun uchun nima maslahat beradi? Uchinchi: sohil haqidagi hikoya nutqning qaysi qismi? Ovoz chiqarib to‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: What is wrong with the opening? What does Mr Reid advise for the ending? And what part of the speech is the beach story?
scenes.say_uz: Boshlanishda nima xato? Janob Rid yakun uchun nima maslahat beradi? Sohil hikoyasi nutqning qaysi qismi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 2 End with a call to action: sign up
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, ochilish juda yassi, chunki Maya shunchaki mavzuni e’lon qiladi. Ikkinchi, murabbiy harakatga chaqiriq tavsiya qiladi: shu hafta ro‘yxatdan o‘tish. Uchinchi, sohil hikoyasi hook vazifasini bajaradi. E’tibor bering: janob Rid “Don’t fade out” deydi, ya’ni so‘nib ketmang. Bu iborani eslab qoling.
scenes.say: The opening is flat because it only announces the topic. The ending should be a call to action. The beach story is the hook.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlanish yassi, chunki faqat mavzuni e’lon qiladi. Yakun harakatga chaqiriq bo‘lishi kerak. Sohil hikoyasi hook.

scenes.title: Mashhur nutq: Cherchill, 1940
board: 'We shall fight on the beaches… we shall never surrender'
scenes.say_native: Endi mashhur nutqlarni tahlil qilamiz. Birinchisi: Uinston Cherchill, 1940 yil iyun, Jamoalar palatasi. Frantsiya mag‘lub bo‘layotgan bir paytda u aytdi: “We shall fight on the beaches… we shall never surrender.” Anafora “we shall fight” ritm va qat’iyat beradi. “Shall” fe’li kelajak va va’da ma’nosini kuchaytiradi. Oxirgi qisqa gap, ko‘p so‘zdan keyin, nuqta qo‘yadi.
scenes.say: We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills; we shall never surrender.
scenes.say_uz: Biz sohillarda jang qilamiz, dalalarda va ko‘chalarda jang qilamiz, tepaliklarda jang qilamiz; hech qachon taslim bo‘lmaymiz.

scenes.title: Mashhur nutq: Martin Lyuter King, 1963
board: 'I have a dream that one day…'
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchisi: Martin Lyuter King, 1963 yil 28 avgust, Vashington, Linkoln yodgorligi oldida. Nutqning yuragi — “I have a dream” anaforasi. Takror har safar yangi orzu qo‘shadi: bolalar, adolat, birodarlik. U Injil ohangidan va jonli obrazlardan foydalanadi, shuning uchun nutq musiqaga o‘xshaydi. Tahlilda har doim so‘rang: takror nima uchun, qaysi tuyg‘uni uyg‘otadi?
scenes.say: I have a dream that one day this nation will rise up and live out the true meaning of its creed.
scenes.say_uz: Mening orzuyim bor: bir kun kelib bu xalq o‘rnidan turib, o‘z e’tiqodining haqiqiy ma’nosiga muvofiq yashaydi.

scenes.title: Mashhur nutq: Linkoln va Kennedi
board: Lincoln 1863: 'of the people, by the people, for the people'
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi va to‘rtinchi misol qisqa, lekin juda mashhur. Linkoln, 1863 yil, Gettisburg: “government of the people, by the people, for the people” — uchlik va epifora, ya’ni “the people” takrorlanadi. Kennedi, 1961 yil: “Ask not what your country can do for you” — xiazm. Ikkalasi ham qisqa, ritmik va esda qoladi. Qisqalik ham ritorik vosita: nutq qancha qisqa, shuncha kuchli.
scenes.say: Lincoln used a tricolon with epistrophe. Kennedy used chiasmus. Both are short, rhythmic and impossible to forget.
scenes.say_uz: Linkoln epifora bilan uchlikdan foydalandi. Kennedi xiazmdan foydalandi. Ikkalasi ham qisqa, ritmik va unutib bo‘lmaydi.

scenes.title: Vositani nomlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta iborani eshiting va har birining vositasini nomlang: uchlik, xiazm, anafora yoki ritorik savol. Birinchi: Veni, vidi, vici. Ikkinchi: Ask not what your country can do for you. Uchinchi: We shall fight, we shall fight. To‘rtinchi: Who wouldn’t want peace?
scenes.say: Name the device. One: veni, vidi, vici. Two: ask not what your country can do for you. Three: we shall fight, we shall fight. Four: who wouldn't want peace?
scenes.say_uz: Vositani nomlang. Bir: keldim, ko‘rdim, yengdim. Ikki: vatan sizga nima qila olishini so‘ramang. Uch: jang qilamiz, jang qilamiz. To‘rt: tinchlikni kim xohlamaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi, uchlik. Ikkinchi, xiazm, chunki tuzilma teskari. Uchinchi, anafora, chunki boshlanish takrorlanadi. To‘rtinchi, ritorik savol, javobi o‘z-o‘zidan ayon. Agar uchtasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi; tahlilda eng muhimi — nom emas, vositaning qanday ta’sir qilishini tushuntirish.
scenes.say: One is a tricolon. Two is chiasmus. Three is anaphora. Four is a rhetorical question.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchisi uchlik. Ikkinchisi xiazm. Uchinchisi anafora. To‘rtinchisi ritorik savol.

scenes.title: Ijro: sur’at va pauza
board: Pause: before and after key words
scenes.say_native: Ijro nutqning yarmi. Birinchi qoida: oddiy suhbatdan sekinroq gapiring, katta zalda tezlik ikki barobar sezilmaydi. Ikkinchi: pauza. Muhim so‘zdan oldin yarim soniya to‘xtasangiz, tinglovchi diqqat bilan kutadi, undan keyin to‘xtasangiz, so‘z qulog‘iga singadi. O‘zbek notiqlarida ham bu bor, lekin ingliz tilida pauza nafaqat nafas olish, u ritorik vositadir.
scenes.say: Slow down. A pause before a key word builds anticipation, and a pause after it lets the idea land. Silence is not empty; it is emphasis.
scenes.say_uz: Sekinlashing. Kalit so‘zdan oldingi pauza kutish yaratadi, undan keyingisi g‘oyaning singishiga imkon beradi. Sukut bo‘sh emas, u ta’kiddir.

scenes.title: Ijro: urg‘u va ohang
board: Stress the key word: I want PEACE
Fall at the end of a finished thought

examples.t: I want PEACE, not victory.
I want peace, not VICTORY.
examples.uz: Men tinchlik istayman, G‘ALABA emas (urg‘u ma’noni o‘zgartiradi).

scenes.say_native: Ohang haqida. Kalit so‘zga urg‘u bering: bir xil gap “I want PEACE” va “I WANT peace” da boshqacha ma’no beradi. Tugallangan fikr oxirida ohang pasayadi, bu ishonch va qat’iyat belgisi. Ko‘tarilgan ohang esa ikkilanishdek eshitiladi. Monoton nutq eng katta xavf: ohangni o‘zgartirib turing. Ritorik savollar ko‘pincha ohangi pasayib tugaydi, chunki ular javobni biladigan odamning savoli.
scenes.say: Stress the word that carries your meaning. Let your voice fall at the end of a finished thought. A rising tone sounds like a question, or a doubt.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’noni ko‘taradigan so‘zga urg‘u bering. Fikr tugaganda ovozingiz pasayib tushsin. Ko‘tarilgan ohang savol yoki shubhadek eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Ijro xatolari
board: ✓ eye contact, slow pace, falling endings
scenes.say_native: Ijrodagi uchta tipik xato. Birinchi: qog‘ozdan tez o‘qish, bunda ko‘z aloqasi yo‘qoladi. Ikkinchi: har gap oxirida ohangni ko‘tarish, ya’ni ingliz tilida ishonchsizlik. Uchinchi: “um, er, you know” kabi so‘z-parazitlar. Davosi: pauza. Siz to‘xtab turgan uch soniya sizga ko‘p tuyuladi, tinglovchiga esa yarim soniya. Mashq qiling va ovozingizni yozib eshiting.
scenes.say: Do not rush, and do not fill silence with um and er. A clean pause sounds confident; a filler sounds nervous.
scenes.say_uz: Shoshilmang va sukutni “um” bilan to‘ldirmang. Toza pauza ishonchli eshitiladi, so‘z-parazit esa asabiy.

scenes.title: Ovoz chiqarib o‘qing
board: We shall not tire / we shall not falter / we shall not fail.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz mashq qilasiz. Quyidagi gapni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing: “We shall not tire, we shall not falter, we shall not fail.” Har vergulda yarim soniya to‘xtang, uchinchi bo‘lakda ovozni pasaytiring va “fail” so‘ziga urg‘u bering. Yana bir marta takrorlang, bu safar sekinroq.
scenes.say: We shall not tire. We shall not falter. We shall not fail.
scenes.say_uz: Biz charchamaymiz. Ikkilanmaymiz. Mag‘lub bo‘lmaymiz.

scenes.title: Ijro javobi
scenes.say_native: Siz buni quyidagicha qildingizmi? Har bo‘lakdan keyin qisqa pauza. Uchinchi bo‘lakda ohang pasayib, “fail” so‘ziga eng kuchli urg‘u tushadi. Bu tricolonning ijrosi: birinchi ikkitasi biroz yuqorida, uchinchisi chuqur va qat’iy. Ovozingizni yozib eshitsangiz, farqni darhol sezasiz.
scenes.say: Pause at each comma, put the strongest stress on fail, and let your voice fall to close the thought.
scenes.say_uz: Har vergulda pauza qiling, eng kuchli urg‘uni “fail” ga bering va fikrni yopish uchun ovozni pasaytiring.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tanlov tayyorgarligi
board: Listen: Dan and Priya before a debate
Q1 Which device does Priya suggest?
Q2 Why does she cut the third question?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Dan va Priya munozaradan oldin nutqni mashq qilishyapti. Ikki savol: Priya qaysi vositani taklif qiladi va nima uchun uchinchi savolni o‘chirishni maslahat beradi? Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Dan: I have three questions in my opening. Priya: Three? Keep one. Too many and it sounds like a quiz. Dan: Then what? Priya: Repeat the same start: Every child, every parent, every teacher. Dan: Like a chant. Priya: Exactly. Then pause.
scenes.say_uz: Dan: Boshlanishimda uchta savol bor. Priya: Uchta? Bittasini qoldir. Ko‘p bo‘lsa viktorinaga o‘xshaydi. Dan: Unda nima? Priya: Bir xil boshlanishni takrorla: har bir bola, har bir ota-ona, har bir o‘qituvchi. Dan: Shior kabi. Priya: Aynan. Keyin pauza qil.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: Q1 Which device does Priya suggest?
Q3 What comes after the repetition?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Priya qaysi vositani taklif qiladi? Ikkinchi: nega ikkita savolni o‘chirish kerak? Uchinchi: takrordan keyin nima keladi? To‘liq gap bilan, baland ovozda javob bering.
scenes.say: Which device does Priya suggest? Why should Dan cut two questions? What comes after the repetition?
scenes.say_uz: Priya qaysi vositani taklif qiladi? Dan nega ikkita savolni o‘chirishi kerak? Takrordan keyin nima keladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2 Too many questions sound like a quiz
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Priya anaforani taklif qiladi, ya’ni “every” so‘zining takrori. Ortiqcha savollar viktorinaga o‘xshab qoladi va ritorik kuchini yo‘qotadi, shuning uchun bittasi yetarli. Takrordan keyin pauza keladi. E’tibor bering, dialogda “like a chant” iborasi bor: bu shiorga o‘xshash degani, nutq tahlilida foydali ibora.
scenes.say: Priya suggests anaphora. Too many questions sound like a quiz. And after the repetition, you pause.
scenes.say_uz: Priya anaforani taklif qiladi. Juda ko‘p savol viktorinaga o‘xshaydi. Takrordan keyin pauza qilinadi.

scenes.title: Nutq tahlili uchun iboralar

examples.t: The speaker uses repetition to build momentum.
examples.uz: Notiq tezlik yaratish uchun takrordan foydalanadi.

examples.t: The effect is a sense of unity.

scenes.say_native: Nutq tahlil qilganda faqat vositani nomlash yetmaydi. Uchta qadam: vositani aniqlang, uni iqtibos bilan ko‘rsating, ta’sirini tushuntiring. Foydali qolip: “The speaker uses anaphora to emphasise determination.” Fe’llar: builds, evokes, reinforces, underlines. Ayniqsa “effect” so‘zi muhim: “The effect is a sense of unity.” Faqat “it is nice” deb yozmang, aniq ta’sirni nomlang.
scenes.say: The speaker uses anaphora to build momentum. The repetition reinforces the message, and the effect is a sense of unity.
scenes.say_uz: Notiq momentum yaratish uchun anaforadan foydalanadi. Takror xabarni mustahkamlaydi, natijada birlik hissi paydo bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 60 soniya
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq: qisqa ishontiruvchi nutqni o‘zingiz tuzing. Mavzu — “Hamma yoshlar xorijiy tilni o‘rganishi kerak”. Rejani ayting: hook, da’vo, dalil, qarshi fikr, harakatga chaqiriq. Kamida bitta uchlik va bitta takror ishlating. Shu yerda to‘xtating va gapiring, yarim daqiqa yetadi.
scenes.say: Give a one-minute persuasive speech: every young person should learn a foreign language. Use a hook, a tricolon, a repetition and a call to action.
scenes.say_uz: Bir daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutq so‘zlang: har bir yosh chet tilini o‘rganishi kerak. Hook, uchlik, takror va harakatga chaqiriqdan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namunaviy nutq
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Boshlanish — hikoya: birinchi marta chet elda yo‘l so‘ragan paytingiz. Uchlik: “It opens doors, minds and hearts”. Anafora: “A language is…”. Qarshi fikr: “Some say translators will do it for us”. Chaqiriq: “Start today”. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi tuzilma va vositalar mavjud.
scenes.say: Remember your first question in a foreign country? A language opens doors, minds and hearts. Some say machines will translate for us, but machines cannot make friends. Start today.
scenes.say_uz: Chet elda birinchi bergan savolingiz esingizdami? Til eshiklarni, ongni va yurakni ochadi. Ba’zilar mashinalar tarjima qiladi deydi, ammo mashinalar do‘st orttira olmaydi. Bugun boshlang.

scenes.title: Takrorlash: vositalar
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Ritorik savol — javob talab qilmaydigan da’vo, bittasi yetarli. Uchlik — uchta parallel bo‘lak, eng kuchlisi oxirida. Antiteza va xiazm — qarama-qarshilik va teskari tuzilma. Anafora va epifora — boshlanish yoki oxirning takrori. Vositalar tuzilma ichida ishlaydi, o‘zi maqsad emas.
scenes.say: Four tools: the rhetorical question, the tricolon, contrast and repetition. Use each with purpose, and never all at once.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta vosita: ritorik savol, uchlik, qarama-qarshilik va takror. Har birini maqsad bilan ishlating, hammasini birdan emas.

scenes.title: Takrorlash: tuzilma va ijro
board: Slow pace · Pauses · Stress · Falling tone
scenes.say_native: Tuzilma: hook, da’vo, dalil, qarshi fikr va harakatga chaqiriq. Tahlilda: vositani nomlang, iqtibos keltiring, ta’sirini tushuntiring. Ijroda: sekin gapiring, pauza qiling, kalit so‘zga urg‘u bering, fikr oxirida ovozni pasaytiring. Cherchill, King, Linkoln va Kennedi misollarini eslang: ularning kuchi soddalikda.
scenes.say: Structure your case, name the device, and explain its effect. Then deliver it slowly, with pauses and falling endings.
scenes.say_uz: Dalilingizni tuzing, vositani nomlang va ta’sirini tushuntiring. So‘ng uni sekin, pauzalar va pasayuvchi ohang bilan ijro eting.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Write and deliver a 2-minute persuasive speech
Use: hook, tricolon, repetition, call to action
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: ikki daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutq yozing va o‘zingiz ovoz chiqarib ijro eting. Nutqda hook, kamida bitta uchlik, bitta takror, qarshi fikr va harakatga chaqiriq bo‘lsin. Telefonda yozib oling va pauzalarni tinglang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: nutq 2 daqiqa atrofida, kamida uchta vosita aniq tanib olinadi. Keyingi darsda murakkab grammatik tuzilmalar ustasi bo‘lishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Write a two-minute persuasive speech and record yourself delivering it. Check that it contains at least three of today's devices.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutq yozing va ijrongizni yozib oling. Unda bugungi vositalardan kamida uchtasi borligini tekshiring.

homework_uz: Ikki daqiqalik ishontiruvchi nutq yozing va ovoz chiqarib ijro eting. Nutqda hook, kamida bitta uchlik, bitta takror, qarshi fikr va harakatga chaqiriq bo‘lsin. Ijroingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: nutq taxminan 2 daqiqa, undagi kamida uchta vosita aniq tanib olinadi.

quiz.q: Which device is 'I came, I saw, I conquered'?
'We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight in the fields' is an example of…
quiz.why_uz: Gaplar bir xil so‘z bilan boshlanadi, bu anafora.

quiz.q: Which sentence has correct parallel structure?
options: She is smart, hardworking and has kindness.
She is smart, hardworking and kind.
She is smart, works hard and kindness.
She is smart, hardworking and being kind.
quiz.why_uz: Uchala bo‘lak bir xil shaklda: sifat, sifat, sifat.

quiz.q: 'Ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country.' is…
quiz.why_uz: Tuzilma teskari bo‘ladi: A-B, B-A — xiazm.

quiz.q: A rhetorical question is asked mainly to…
quiz.why_uz: Ritorik savol javob olish uchun emas, fikrni kuchaytirish uchun.

quiz.q: What is a weak way to open a persuasive speech?
quiz.why_uz: Mavzuni e’lon qilish zaif ochilish; hikoya yoki fakt kuchliroq.

options: So today I ask you to…

quiz.q: Correct: 'Not only ___ cheap, but it is also good.'
quiz.why_uz: Salbiy ibora boshida bo‘lsa, inversiya: not only is it.

options: Rising tone at every sentence end
Clear pauses and a falling tone
quiz.why_uz: Pauza va pasayuvchi ohang ishonch beradi.

quiz.q: In 'of the people, by the people, for the people', the repeated words come at the…
quiz.why_uz: “The people” har bo‘lakning oxirida takrorlanadi — epifora.
